Resolves #21146

Three groups gain covers made by recipes: Lists & Galleries (its four records, re-shot), Containers & Layouts (`layout-form`, so the group publishes for the first time, with its tile named) and Dashboard & Docking (its three uncovered dock examples, plus the `dock-choreography` tile re-shot at 640 × 360, handed over from #21121 by its owner). The section now counts 47 examples in 17 groups. Every recipe waits for a settled state: the gallery recipes anchor their region on the selected item, so the capture waits for the camera to stop, and the tear-out recipe waits for its pane's pop-out action. The bytes are in neomjs/pages#107, which merges first.

Evidence: L3 (the producer's capture at this head, rendered through the Portal with the new bytes, and two cold readers) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-4). Residual: AC-1 for Workers & Platform (`offscreen-canvas`, an external demo), Residual-Owner: #21120. AC-2, AC-5 and AC-3's one-theme half are held with the overview, Residual-Owner: #21306.

## Deltas from ticket
- **One theme (AC-3).** A recipe's `theme` sets the browser's color scheme, and only the Portal reads it. An example opens in the first theme of its `neo-config.json`. One theme for every tile would change which theme the examples open in, which changes what a visitor gets. Each tile shows its example as it opens. That is the frame rule of #20679: the example's own surface. The design seat may reject this; the alternative is a change to the examples' theme order, not to recipes.
- **`dock-choreography`** was on #21121's re-shoot list. Declaring the `dashboard` capture family makes its recipe a validator requirement, so Grace handed it over (her DM, 06:55Z). It is its own commit, `96ff9f20e0`. Its Editor pane shows a wall clock, so its bytes change with every run.
- **`offscreen-canvas` is not captured here.** Its devmode URL is on `https://neomjs.github.io/`, outside a local run's base origin. Vega's branch for #21120 now accepts a recipe for an external demo (her `f67dcbec5e`). A run from its own origin (`--base-url https://neomjs.github.io/`) captures a blank canvas, though: a canvas worker draws the points, nothing in the DOM marks the moment they are drawn, and the script has no timed sleeps by design. A pixel-readiness check is offered on #21120. Until then the Workers & Platform card keeps its 13.x cover.
- **`dock-tear-out` keeps a sparse cover.** Its panes are placeholders and its story needs a second window, so a cold reader failed the frame as mostly empty. Making it telling needs new example content, which is out of scope. The design read on #21146 names it to the slate (#21145) as a renew candidate.
- **`apps/portal/resources/images/examples/devmode/dock-choreography-13-2.jpg` is removed.** The Portal reads covers from Pages (`List.mjs`, `imageBasePath`), so once the record named the 14 re-shoot, the package-contents guard reported this local copy as unnamed.
- `seo.json` gains only the `/examples/layouts` entry the generator derives. A full regeneration also moves 33 unrelated `lastmod` dates and adds one guide route, which are not this PR's.
